title: Critique: the theory makes too much of the system phenomenal

statements.text: Weisberg objects that the theory makes too much of the system phenomenal, and argues that global availability should give way to perspectivalness and transparency as the notions that do the explaining. So read, the theory sits close to monitoring, or higher-order, theories of consciousness rather than first-order or global workspace theories.
